question: A print shop starts the day with 110 flyers printed. By midmorning, 25 more are printed. By midday, 63 more are added. A citywide campaign then multiplies the whole batch by 9, a run that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. Then 21 more flyers are printed for a late order. Finally, 10 more are printed as extras. How many flyers does the shop have now?

Kai's video clip was 127 seconds long. He added a 3-second title card at the start, then cut out a 99-second scene that dragged, and trimmed another 3 seconds of dead air. Finally he added 35 seconds of credits at the end. Kai edits in seconds rather than minutes, even though the sharing site displays the length in minutes, since sixty seconds make one minute. How many seconds long is the finished clip?

On Monday morning a food bank had 87 boxes of pasta, and a supermarket delivered 68 more before lunch. In the early afternoon a matched giving scheme doubled the number of boxes on the shelves. Later that afternoon a school brought 49 boxes and a church group brought 76. In the evening two neighbours dropped off 26 boxes and then 44 boxes. The food bank opens 5 days a week. How many boxes of pasta are on the shelves?

A manufacturer began with 225 units. He multiplied by 8 for production factor. He divided by 2 for two facilities. He subtracted 853 for major order (converting to remaining inventory). He added 26 from replenishment (measured in inventory units). Throughout the day, morning production, afternoon orders, and evening inventory tracked one measurement. What was the inventory unit count?

A theatre workshop had 17 rolls of gaffer tape in its cupboard. It threw out 3 rolls whose glue had dried up. An order from the supplier then brought in 53 more rolls. Every roll holds 9 metres of tape. Building the set used up 136 metres. The workshop has been running for a dozen seasons. How many metres of tape are left?

A warehouse robotics team starts a trial with 223 boxes queued on the conveyor belt. A morning shipment adds 39 more boxes to the queue. A software update then speeds up processing so much that the effective queue count grows to 9 times what it was. The system separately logs 500 error alerts that engineers later confirm were harmless. A late addition from receiving adds 6 more boxes to the queue. A second update boosts the queue count to 2 times what it had grown to. Finally, the boxes are split evenly into 4 shipping lanes, and the story follows just one of those lanes from here. How many boxes are queued in that one lane?

A bakery started the day with 61 cookies. In the morning, they baked 7 more. Then they made twice as many cookies (doubling the batch). They then divided the cookies into 4 equal packs. Each pack was then divided into 8 individual cookies. Finally, they multiplied by 5 for the display count. How many cookies were in the final display arrangement?

Amir had 114 blank keycards for the new building, and the system logs access times in minutes rather than in hours. His colleague Ruth, who had ordered more than he had, gave him 68 cards from her own box. Testing showed 31 of the cards to be faulty and they were destroyed. Every working card is programmed to open 9 doors in the complex. The security review then revoked 26 of those door permissions. How many door permissions were active?

A manager tracked tasks over the week starting with 179. A brainstorming session multiplied this fourfold. She added 4 administrative tasks. Complexity analysis multiplied work by 9. The team completed 3618 tasks by afternoon. She then added 34 client requests and 66 integration tasks. How many tasks remained?

A museum records its tours in hours rather than in minutes. On Friday morning the desk had 83 audio guides, and 50 were handed out to a coach party. Before lunch a school group took 8 more, and in the afternoon 14 went to other visitors. The museum has 9 galleries. That evening the director ordered enough guides for the desk to hold 4 times as many as were left. On Saturday 6 guides were sent away for repair. How many audio guides does the desk have now?

In the morning Nell checked the first seed tray in her nursery: it had been sown with 71 seeds but 54 of them had failed to sprout. Each of her shelves holds 3 trays like that one, every tray with the same number of sprouted seedlings, and each greenhouse has 7 shelves. Each tray is 40 centimetres wide. In the afternoon she confirmed that all 7 of her greenhouses matched the first one. In the evening she reported that all 5 farms in the cooperative had grown exactly the same as hers, a dozen years after the cooperative was founded. How many seedlings sprouted across the cooperative?

A storage facility has 228 items. In the morning, it gains 6 (234). By afternoon, 43 are sold (191). By evening, 90 more are sold (101). Finally, 60 more are removed for returns (41). How many items remain in storage?

A club had 238 chairs and sold 88 of them at auction. A school borrowed 97 chairs and never brought them back. A grant then let the club triple the number of chairs it still had. A fire officer later condemned 147 of the chairs as unsafe. Every chair that is left will be hired out 7 times this year. The clubhouse itself was built in 1962. How many hires will that come to?

A warehouse started with 195 items. She added 58. This total was multiplied by 6. Then 823 were shipped. She added 35 back. Finally, 401 were removed for reordering. Throughout the day, how many items remained?

A student had 18 coins initially. They added 47 from allowance. They removed 49 for shopping. They added 24 from a gift. They removed 26 for savings. The school bank had 1000 accounts. How many coins left?

At the start of Monday a food bank had 111 parcels ready on the racks. During the morning volunteers packed 80 more, and before lunch a supermarket sent in 51. In the afternoon a school collection added 62 parcels. That evening 34 parcels were driven out to families. Late at night a bakery van dropped off 72 more parcels. How many parcels does the food bank have now?

In the morning the bakery had 84 pies and baked 12 more, then sold 31. In the afternoon each remaining pie was cut into 4 slices. In the evening every slice sold for 5 dollars. How many dollars did the slices bring in?

A city bike-share station is checked three times a day, and its records are kept in whole hours rather than in minutes. At the start of Monday morning the station had 150 bicycles in its racks. A delivery lorry arrived and doubled that number before eight o'clock. During the afternoon commute half of all the bicycles at the station were ridden away and never returned. In the evening 22 bicycles were taken to the workshop for repair. The city now plans 7 stations of exactly this size, each holding as many bicycles as this one ended the day with. How many bicycles will the city need for the 7 stations?
A printer had 214 sheets of paper. They multiplied by 7 for a large job. They used 268 sheets. They multiplied by 9 for the next project. They added 75 premium sheets. How many sheets are available?

James collected 163 trading cards. He traded them with 4 other kids, giving each kid the same cards, so his collection was multiplied by 4. Then he found 73 new cards at a flea market. Afterward, he and his friend doubled their combined cards by trading—multiplied by 6. Finally, he organized all his cards into groups of 4. James' sister had a dozen rare cards but they weren't added to his collection. How many cards does James have in total?

A community kitchen baked 228 bread rolls for a street party. 171 rolls were eaten during the afternoon. A neighbour brought 31 more rolls from her own oven, and a bakery donated 20 more. All of the rolls left on the table were packed equally into 3 boxes for the night shelter. Sofia carried more boxes out to the van than Marco did. How many rolls does one of those boxes hold?

A nursery started the season with 222 tulip bulbs and sold 185 of them to a garden centre straight away. Every bulb that was left produced 9 offsets during the summer. A neighbour donated 65 more offsets, and 17 others turned up in a forgotten tray. The nursery's main greenhouse has 4 heated benches. In the autumn each offset was divided into 6 plantable pieces, and a hard frost later killed 1006 of those pieces. How many plantable pieces did the nursery still have?

A store had 74 items initially. By morning, 51 more arrived. Then 3 additional items were added. The total multiplied by 5. They divided by 5 again to balance the count, converting to inventory hours. A warehouse stocked 1000 items but separate location. How many items in balanced inventory?

Malik started Saturday morning with 163 baseball cards in his collection. By midday, a trading fair had grown his collection to 7 times its original size. In the afternoon, he traded away 889 duplicate cards to other collectors. That evening, his cousin gave him 7 more rare cards as a gift. Later that night, he donated 42 cards to his school's card-collecting club. Malik has been collecting cards for a dozen years now, ever since his grandfather gave him his first pack. How many cards did Malik have in his collection after the donation?

A business had 192 items Monday morning. They added 51 Tuesday. They added 56 Wednesday. They added 67 Thursday. They removed 122 for distribution. The company had 8 departments. How many items distributed?
